name: Quasar-Bench
description: Quasar-Bench evaluates open-domain question-answering performance, focusing on retrieval-augmented and knowledge-intensive QA over a collection of benchmark queries. It measures a model's ability to find and synthesize relevant information to produce correct answers given limited or noisy context. The benchmark is intended to stress retrieval quality and answer generation fidelity rather than dialog or instruction-following behavior.
reputation: A niche QA/retrieval benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption in retrieval and open-domain QA research.
